text.p: Andres continues to weaken as it moves towards the coast of Central America. Most of the heavier rains associated with this system are still occurring off the coast. We expect this system to move inland and then dissipate during this weekend. Heavy rain will likely cause flooding and possible mudslides during this period. Winds become light and variable during the weekend.

Tropical depression 07w will gradually gain strength as it tracks west-northwest during the weekend. Top winds increase from 35 mph to about 75 mph during the period. The track will keep it mostly over open water from north of the Caroline islands to east-southeast of the Mariana islands during this weekend. This will mainly impact shipping during the period.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
